title: Leadership References
intro: Perspectives from executives and engineering leaders I’ve worked closely with across product leadership, organizational execution, and complex delivery environments.

items.quote: I’ve built businesses where mistakes cost real money, so I don’t trust people with important work easily. Nikola became someone I rely on because he brings ownership, clarity, and the ability to move difficult product problems forward without constant oversight. That kind of trust is earned.
items.name: Ivan Stoiljkovic

items.quote: Balancing business priorities, stakeholder expectations, and technical realities in fast-moving commercial environments requires both structure and judgment. That combination consistently helped teams stay focused on what created the strongest business impact.
items.name: Camille Boujassy
items.role: Better Collective | Head of Group Partner & Business Operations

items.quote: Strong organization, practical leadership, and clear prioritization made collaboration highly effective. The focus was always on outcomes, long-term product decisions, and creating an environment where teams could perform at a high level.
items.name: Tarik Alikadic

items.quote: Strong product thinking, technical understanding, and a clear view of the bigger picture made collaboration highly effective. Product decisions were thoughtful, grounded in business context, and aligned with long-term platform goals.
items.name: Alen Veljan
